title: 'As you play this, name a tag' clause not implemented
expected: Card def /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/the-list.ts:4-15 has no `abilities` field, only rulesText. Running parseAbilities() on that rulesText yields exactly one ability — the [Exhaust] activated modify-might with target filter {tag:"named"} (parser/impl/effects-might.ts:120-139); the "As you play this, name a tag" sentence produces nothing (no parser rule matches "name a tag" — the only "As you play this" handlers are additional-cost patterns in spells.ts:74/155, replacement.ts:25, effects-conditional.ts:57). Engine side: there is a name-card effect (abilities/effects/name-card.ts, namedCard meta) but no name-tag equivalent; grep for namedTag/name-tag in riftbound-engine/src, server.ts, and public/js/gameplay returns nothing. target-resolver.ts:737-739 treats filter.tag "named" as a literal tag string via tags.includes("named"), so no named tag is ever prompted for or stored.
observed: playGear resolved straight to base with no pendingChoice, no prompt in UI, and no named-tag stored in card meta; parseAbilities() output for this rulesText contains only the [Exhaust] activated ability — the name-a-tag clause is dropped
